title: Witch in Rain with Pumpkin
description: A green-skinned witch with long blue hair crouches in the rain under a blue starry umbrella, holding a large carved jack-o'-lantern featuring a dragon design. She sits on wet cobblestones surrounded by lit candles, a small cauldron, scattered rings, and a potion bottle, with blurred glowing orbs in the dark background.
